craft_notes: Sthāyin: any-organ universalizer (the method generalizes: strike or block it). Rows: row 3 (entered→shines). Close: shines (#4 in block — the shining-verb is the block's pulse: there-itself-self SHINES). Rejected: 'stimulus' — killed: striking kept; 'chakra' — killed: organ kept (indriya).

lines: entered nondual void — there itself, self shines.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yasya kasyendriyasyāpi vyāghātāc ca nirodhataḥ | praviṣṭasyādvaye śūnye tatraivātmā prakāśate

reads_against.argmap: What shines at the void's entry? → Enter the nondual void through any organ — there the self shines itself.
c1_essence: Any organ's strike or block: nondual void, self shines.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with adbhuta (stillness startled by its own gates)
